paper_verdict.estimator_family: SURE (seemingly unrelated regression) two-equation simultaneous system, cross-section
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Single-year (2000) cross-section of 126 states; outcome LGGDP is log of real GDP level (constant 1995 USD), not per capita or growth; exposure is log internet hosts per 10,000 (log-log elasticity); the 'simulations' are SURE regressions on real data, but the same 126 states recur in all four specifications. Printed T-ratio 6.425 is identical for LHOSTS in Simulation 2 and LGGDP in Simulation 1, so the t-ratio column may contain a typo; the SE is used.

paper_verdict.estimator_family: Panel fixed effects (two-way FE, country-clustered robust SE), with pooled OLS/RE comparisons and system GMM as robustness
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Exposure is a PCA-based composite AI Capability Index that is standardized, so coefficients are per 1 SD of an index mixing AI-hardware imports with ICT, electricity and financial-inclusion readiness, not per unit of a single technology. Outcome is log real GDP per worker (labor productivity). Many estimates come from the same 63-country, 2005-2019 sample and overlap (pooled OLS, FE, lags, GMM, narrow definition). Interaction terms (879-10 to 879-14) are conditional effects and are not comparable with main effects; 879-9 is the low-income reference-group effect. GMM and lagged estimates use lagged regressors, and pooled OLS is attributed by the authors to omitted variable bias. Sample is low and lower-middle income countries (LMICs).
